content.comment_body: Hello, I want to display a text message below an existing message, rather than replacing the whole display. Is this possible?
Your question lacks detail. Could you clarify your requirements or provide an example?
I am referring to using the [product_name] operator device. For example, I first display the message: DARIN DOWN 1 Then I want to add a new message below the first one: DRAIN DOWN 1 VALVE IS FAULTY
You can make use of the I/O Status Name feature. See the attached example.

Thank you for your help. My scenario is a bit more complex: The first line is always the step name, like: DRAIN DOWN 1 The second line needs to change based on three possible cases: 1 - DRAIN VALVE IS FAULTY 2 - INPUT OR OUTPUT VALVE IS FAULTY 3 - REMAINING TIME OF A TIMER Is there a way to achieve this?
That isn't possible except by making multiple text messages for all possible combinations and then using OR and AND blocks to select them.

You can place up to two different text values on a single line. If you require more than two different texts in one line, you will have to create separate message texts, all starting with the same basic information. Note that a [product_name] operator device does not offer the flexibility of an HMI display.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to show both a static line and a dynamic, context-dependent second line on a [product_name] operator device display. Other participants clarify that the hardware is limited in flexibility, allowing only basic text changes, which can require many pre-defined messages to cover all possible scenarios.
analysis.user_expectations: User is looking for an efficient way to display a fixed label with a situation-dependent message underneath, without having to create numerous individual messages or replacing the entire screen display.
